subjects.label: Suspect surveillance, detention and the Committee of General Security
subjects.meaning: The broad Law of Suspects enabled local watch committees to arrest loosely defined enemies and use civisme certification as a pervasive instrument of surveillance and detention. subjects.label: Politically managed trials in Paris: autumn1793 and the Hébertists
subjects.meaning: The trials and executions of Marie-Antoinette, leading Girondins, and other prominent figures gave the Terror famous public victims while masking its predominantly provincial toll. The later Hébertist trial again subordinated defense to the desired result.
